_meta.name: Couldn't Afford Prescriptions
_meta.unit: percent of people who did not get needed prescription drugs in the past 12 months because of cost
_meta.source: CDC/NCHS Health, United States (National Health Interview Survey), via Data Query System
_meta.note: NHIS, all ages, crude percent, as published in Health, United States. The series ENDS AT 2019: the NHIS questionnaire was redesigned that year and NCHS has not carried this item forward on the new basis. The closest replacement item, asked of adults 18+ since 2019 ("did not take medication as prescribed to save money"), runs 2019 9.6%, 2020 8.3%, 2021 6.8%, 2022 6.8%, 2023 7.8%, 2024 7.8%, 2025 7.6% — a different question, shown here in the note rather than spliced onto the chart.
_meta.method: SODA p4r5-qsgs, subtopic 'Nonreceipt of needed prescription drugs due to cost', group Total, crude
